jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SARIS

We're a San Francisco & Montreal based applied AI startup that's building the future of work in the banking industry. We are tackling a $100 billion/yr problem, doubling every quarter and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with multi-turn AI agentic systems.

Our goal is to tackle the type of automation problems that require long-context reasoning, tool orchestration across legacy systems, and strict compliance loops: the ones without known answers.

We’ve shipped real agents that handle real customer workflows in production. With a growing customer base and live deployments, we’re scaling up fast and looking for deeply technical builders who want to have outsized impact early.

 


THE ROLE

We’re looking for our next rockstar— AI Product Manager focused on Implementation and Onboarding to lead AI transformation in the back office of Banks/ Credit Union. You’ll own the customer’s transformation journey from early scoping to full AI implementation ensuring smooth execution and maximum ROI. This role combines client-facing collaboration with product-oriented documentation and delivery. This role is part customer engagement and part product scoping.

 


YOUR MISSION IS TO

 - Lead onboarding and implementation across customer departments, ensuring timelines, scope, and expectations are aligned.

 - Lead discovery calls to map use cases, edge cases, and integration needs.

 - Create product scoping documents and delivery blueprints for agentic AI workflows.

 - Engage executive stakeholders, deliver clear, compelling insights on how Agentic AI drives measurable ROI and transforms operations at scale.

 - Collaborate across the team with sales, customer success, and product to ensure customer success.
   
    


WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years of experience in implementation, product management, consulting, or enterprise onboarding—ideally with AI products in the banking/credit union industry.

 - Domain experience in an American bank or credit union

 - Expertise in workflow mapping, use case identification, and translating needs into product specs

 - Effective communication skills —experience and comfort in engaging with senior executives and leaders at financial institutions.

 - Growth mindset and curiosity - Have a growth mindset, drive initiatives, and a strong desire to help customers succeed.
   
    


WHY JOIN SARIS?

 - 🏦 Join us in building the future of work for the trillion-dollar banking industry using cutting edge AI technology.

 - ⚡Tackle ambiguous implementation challenges with no clear answers.

 - 💲Competitive compensation with premium benefits and equity package.

 - 🤝Work with a stellar team of engineers, builders, and leaders; including repeat YC founders with a successful exit (Ready Education).

 - 📈We already have production agents live with revenue-generating customers

 - 🐦 🔥Our team is backed by Tier 1 Silicone Valley VCs
